functions.name: New_rtl8651_rxPktPreprocess
functions.proof: Reads RX DVLANID at DW4 bits16..27, source-port bits13..15; extport CPU bit and magic VLAN 0xa530/0xa533 match GPL function

functions.name: rx_desc_not_empty
functions.proof: Reads CPURPDCR ring, subtracts New_rxDescRing_base, shift5, then OWN via KSEG1 if software index equals CDP index; matches GPL

functions.name: New_swNic_receive
functions.proof: Uses New_rxDescRing[0]/New_currRxPkthdrDescIndex[0], checks checksum, allocates replacement skb, RX field decode and OWN publish; called by RX IRAM path

functions.name: _New_swNic_send
functions.proof: Four args; full ring check, 32-byte descriptor, payload length+4, cache writeback, sync then uncached OWN then CPUICR TXFD; exact GPL compiled branch

functions.name: New_swNic_send
functions.proof: Disables IRQ, calls _New_swNic_send 0x8052a708 and restores IRQ state

functions.name: New_swNic_txDone
functions.proof: Reads CPUTPDCR table, subtracts New_txDescRing_base, shift5; frees SKBs until done index reaches captured CDP, no OWN test

functions.name: New_swNic_freeTxRing
functions.proof: Loops four New_txDescRingCnt/tx_skb arrays and frees all nonnull SKBs; called by New_swNic_reInit 0x80262e88

functions.name: re865x_start_xmit
functions.proof: net_device_ops function pointer at 0x8054d528, next to re865x_open/close; re865x_probe sets ops=0x8054d518 at 0x80659878..7c. Exact GPL body; calls NEW send and completion.

functions.name: interrupt_dsr_rx
functions.proof: re865x_open 0x8024be24 lui a1,0x8053; 0x8024bf4c addiu a1,-0x6e48; tasklet_init at 0x8024bf54. Direct New_swNic_receive call at 0x8052922c.

functions.name: interrupt_dsr_tx
functions.proof: re865x_open loads 0x805283f8 and passes it to tasklet_init at 0x8024bf68; directly calls New_swNic_txDone at 0x80528400.
